metadata.title: Enterprise Architecture Management Platform Data Assets
metadata.description: Starter catalog of key architecture, portfolio, risk, roadmap, and usage data assets for the Enterprise Architecture Management Platform domain.

assets.name: Architecture Object
assets.description: Canonical modeled object such as application, capability, process, technology, data entity, initiative, risk, or organization unit.
assets.accessScope: architecture modeling, reporting, scenario analysis, and governance workflows
assets.businessMeaning: The primary reusable unit in the enterprise architecture knowledge graph.

interfaces.name: architecture-object api
interfaces.description: Create, update, query, and govern architecture objects.

governance.retention: customer contract retention plus audit window

assets.name: Model Relationship
assets.description: Directed relationship between architecture objects, including dependency, ownership, support, realization, lifecycle, and impact links.
assets.accessScope: impact analysis, dependency mapping, roadmap planning, and traceability
assets.businessMeaning: Explains how enterprise objects depend on, realize, constrain, or govern each other.

interfaces.name: model-relationship api
interfaces.description: Query and update relationship evidence for architecture analysis.

governance.retention: customer contract retention plus audit window

assets.name: Application Inventory
assets.description: Catalog of business applications, owners, lifecycle states, costs, capabilities supported, technologies used, risks, and rationalization candidates.
assets.accessScope: application portfolio management and investment governance
assets.businessMeaning: Shows where the enterprise invests in application capabilities and where rationalization or modernization is needed.

interfaces.name: application-inventory api
interfaces.description: Portfolio data access for application assessment and reporting.

governance.retention: active portfolio plus historical audit window
governance.sharingPolicy: limited to authorized portfolio, architecture, finance, and risk users

assets.name: Business Capability
assets.description: Business capability hierarchy with owners, maturity, strategic importance, supporting applications, transformation needs, and investment signals.
assets.accessScope: business architecture, portfolio prioritization, and roadmap planning
assets.businessMeaning: Creates a common language between business strategy and technology execution.

interfaces.name: business-capability api
interfaces.description: Capability model access for mapping, maturity analysis, and roadmap alignment.

governance.retention: active capability model plus historical versions
governance.sharingPolicy: shared with approved business and architecture stakeholders

assets.name: Technology Standard
assets.description: Approved, tolerated, contained, or prohibited technology standards with lifecycle, risk, ownership, and exception evidence.
assets.accessScope: technology risk, standards governance, and solution review
assets.businessMeaning: Controls technology lifecycle decisions and helps identify risk from obsolete or nonstandard technologies.

interfaces.name: technology-standard api
interfaces.description: Access to technology standards and lifecycle policy data.

governance.retention: active standards plus exception audit history
governance.sharingPolicy: shared with architecture, engineering, security, and procurement roles

assets.name: Portfolio Decision
assets.description: Decision records for retain, invest, migrate, retire, defer, approve, reject, or escalate actions across applications, technologies, initiatives, and roadmaps.
assets.businessMeaning: Captures why a transformation or portfolio decision was made and which evidence supported it.

interfaces.name: portfolio-decision api
interfaces.description: Decision record access for governance and audit workflows.

governance.sharingPolicy: strictly controlled internal and audit usage

assets.name: Roadmap Plan
assets.description: Transformation roadmap with horizons, milestones, dependencies, target states, initiative mappings, and sequencing assumptions.
assets.accessScope: roadmap planning, target architecture, scenario analysis, and executive reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Turns architecture insight into sequenced change decisions.

interfaces.name: roadmap-plan api
interfaces.description: Roadmap and target state access for planning surfaces.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared with approved strategy, portfolio, architecture, and delivery users

assets.name: Integration Telemetry
assets.description: Connector runs, sync freshness, source coverage, import errors, mapping drift, and data-quality signals from connected systems.
assets.accessScope: integration operations, data quality, and model trust monitoring
assets.businessMeaning: Shows whether operating data feeding architecture decisions is current and reliable.

assets.name: Governance Evidence
assets.description: Review notes, approval trails, control attestations, policy exceptions, risk acceptances, and architecture board evidence.
assets.accessScope: risk, compliance, audit, and architecture governance workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides defensible proof that architecture and technology decisions followed policy.

interfaces.name: governance-evidence api
interfaces.description: Controlled access to governance evidence and audit trails.

governance.sharingPolicy: least privilege for risk, compliance, audit, and authorized architecture users

assets.name: User Contribution
assets.description: Survey responses, ownership updates, comments, review actions, work item edits, and stakeholder validation events.
assets.accessScope: collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and model freshness workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Captures how stakeholders keep architecture data current and validate decision evidence.

interfaces.name: user-contribution events
interfaces.description: Contribution stream for engagement and data-quality scoring.

governance.sharingPolicy: limited to authorized workspace and audit views

assets.name: AI Insight
assets.description: AI-generated summary, recommendation, anomaly, classification, scenario explanation, or natural-language answer with evidence references.
assets.accessScope: AI-assisted modeling, evidence review, and insight delivery
assets.businessMeaning: Accelerates architecture work while preserving traceability to approved enterprise evidence.

interfaces.name: ai-insight api
interfaces.description: Access to reviewed AI insights and evidence links.
